title: DPS Srinagar wins national filmmaking title for short film ‘AALAV’

ai.summary: Delhi Public School Srinagar won a national film competition for a short film exploring mental privacy and human relationships.

facts.claim: DPS Srinagar won the national title at the Filmmaking Competition 2026 organised by The Global Education & Leadership Foundation (tGELF) JA India for its psychological short film AALAV (The Call)
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 27: Delhi Public School, Srinagar, won the national title at the Filmmaking Competition 2026 organised by The Global Education & Leadership Foundation (tGELF) JA India for its psychological short film AALAV (The Call).

facts.claim: The competition drew entries from 175 schools across India, with 20 films making it through to the final shortlist
